title: Legacy Text Input Contract Audit, TTUTIL Suitability & Adapter Qualification
qualification_scope: source-bound revision-53 input-family inventory, parser/normalization/scientific boundary, defaults and error-contract audit, TTUTIL suitability classification, normalized parser-equivalence model, negative-case architecture and bounded pilot selection; no runtime TTUTIL adapter qualification
principal_findings: TTUTIL is useful parser infrastructure but is not a drop-in parser for the revision-53 legacy grammar
ANIMO41 GENERAL named records are sequentially order-sensitive while public TTUTIL reading is name-based and order-independent
legacy label-addressed files and sequential management streams need explicit compatibility behaviour before any TTUTIL substitution
source-only defaults and compatibility fallbacks must be materialized in the normalized dump with rule ids
INITIAL and restart state remain specialized state adapters
external crop and soil-temperature time series remain specialized forcing/exchange adapters
binary hydrology remains outside TTUTIL and maps only semantically to ARCH05 hydrology exchange
GHGMais is rejected under the revision-53 adapter until a provenance-qualified versioned lineage exists

pilot_selection.pilot_B_candidate: MAT non-GHG static core after Pilot A
pilot_selection.reason: TTUTIL source/version/dependency provenance and strict legacy compatibility policy are not yet pinned

next_safe_steps: pin an exact TTUTIL source/version/license provenance without vendoring it by accident
build an exact legacy-parser normalization dump oracle for DIRECT then MAT
execute positive and negative parser-only equivalence fixtures against the frozen B0 cases and synthetic descendants
only then implement a bounded TTUTIL-backed prototype and classify it separately from this audit
